name: Standard temperature heat detector HEAD ONLY (Xpert card Style- )- LPCB APPROVED
family: Context Plus Xpert Card Based Analogue Addressable Detectors
summary: The Context Plus Intelligent Addressable Heat Detector model 55000-400IMC monitors temperature by using a single thermistor which provides a count output proportional to the external air temperature. This heat detector is classified as an A2S device and will report an alarm at 55°C.
description: Patented XPERT Card addressing that provides simple, user friendly and accurate identification of detector location. This addressing card simplifies and speeds up installation and commissioning and eliminates addressing errors during maintenance and service.
features: Unaffected by wind or atmospheric pressure.
Alarm flag for fast alarm reporting.
Alarm address for fast location of alarm.
Has a high immunity from corruption.
Ideal in environments that are dirty or smoky under normal conditions
Well-suited to warehouses, loading bays and car parks
